description: This file contains trigger decoder functions for Mitsubishi engines, including configuration for Mitsubishi 4G18 engine and a specific trigger shape for Ford Aspire. It defines trigger initialization and event timing for ignition signal processing.

methods.name: void configureFordAspireTriggerShape(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Configures the trigger shape for a Ford Aspire, setting synchronization and adding timing events.

methods.name: void initializeMitsubishi4g18(TriggerShape * s)
methods.description: Initializes the trigger shape for Mitsubishi 4G18 engine, defining trigger events, timing, and synchronization settings.
